questions.question: Line l passes through the points (2, 0) and (3, -6) in the xy-plane. If line l is translated up 7 units and right 9 units, what is the slope of the new line?
questions.explanation: A translation does not change slope. Slope = (-6 - (0))/(3 - (2)) = -6.

questions.question: Line l passes through the points (1, -2) and (4, -1) in the xy-plane. If line l is translated up 9 units and right 8 units, what is the slope of the new line?
questions.explanation: A translation does not change slope. Slope = (-1 - (-2))/(4 - (1)) = 1/3.

questions.question: Line l passes through the points (-2, 0) and (3, -1) in the xy-plane. If line l is translated up 2 units and right 8 units, what is the slope of the new line?
questions.explanation: A translation does not change slope. Slope = (-1 - (0))/(3 - (-2)) = -1/5.

questions.question: Line l passes through the points (-3, -2) and (-2, -6) in the xy-plane. If line l is translated up 9 units and right 3 units, what is the slope of the new line?
questions.explanation: A translation does not change slope. Slope = (-6 - (-2))/(-2 - (-3)) = -4.

questions.question: Line l passes through the points (1, 1) and (5, 8) in the xy-plane. If line l is translated up 6 units and right 6 units, what is the slope of the new line?
questions.explanation: A translation does not change slope. Slope = (8 - (1))/(5 - (1)) = 7/4.

questions.question: Line l passes through the points (1, -5) and (3, 3) in the xy-plane. If line l is translated up 5 units and right 6 units, what is the slope of the new line?
questions.explanation: A translation does not change slope. Slope = (3 - (-5))/(3 - (1)) = 4.

questions.question: Line l passes through the points (1, -5) and (2, 3) in the xy-plane. If line l is translated up 7 units and right 2 units, what is the slope of the new line?
questions.explanation: A translation does not change slope. Slope = (3 - (-5))/(2 - (1)) = 8.

questions.question: Line l passes through the points (-3, -4) and (2, -11) in the xy-plane. If line l is translated up 9 units and right 2 units, what is the slope of the new line?
questions.explanation: A translation does not change slope. Slope = (-11 - (-4))/(2 - (-3)) = -7/5.

questions.question: Line l passes through the points (-4, 6) and (-3, 12) in the xy-plane. If line l is translated up 5 units and right 6 units, what is the slope of the new line?
questions.explanation: A translation does not change slope. Slope = (12 - (6))/(-3 - (-4)) = 6.

questions.question: Line l passes through the points (0, 5) and (2, 9) in the xy-plane. If line l is translated up 2 units and right 3 units, what is the slope of the new line?
questions.explanation: A translation does not change slope. Slope = (9 - (5))/(2 - (0)) = 2.
